create_tesseract_ocr_model: create a TesseractOcrModel instance with enabled flag, artifacts path, options, and accelerator options
run_ocr_on_pages: run OCR on a batch of pages using TesseractOcrModel to extract text cells with bounding boxes
detect_orientation_script: detect document orientation and script using OSD reader for auto language detection
extract_text_cells: extract text cells with confidence scores and bounding rectangles from OCR image regions
post_process_ocr_cells: post-process extracted OCR text cells and attach them to a conversion result page
